"''That is ''not'' his name. He is a killer. A surgeon, or once was, by the name of Dr. Cornelius Evazan. Be wary of him.|Jerriko and Wuher|{{StoryCite|story=We Don't Serve Their Kind Here|book=From a Certain Point of View}}}} '''Jerriko''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Mutant/Canon|mutant]] [[human]] [[bureaucrat]]. ==Biographic== On the [[Standard day|day]] that [[Luke Skywalker]] met [[Han Solo]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine]], Jerriko was present in the [[cantina]], smoking a [[pipe]] at the counter. He offered his services to the [[bartender]] [[Wuher]] to [[Death|kill]] [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]], but before he could do anything, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] took care of both Evazan and [[Ponda Baba|his associate]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. ==Behind the scenes== In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Dannik Jerriko|Jerriko]] was given the first name Dannik and identified as an [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in "[[Soup's On: The Pipe Smoker's Tale]]," a short story written by [[Jennifer Roberson]] that was included in ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]'', which was released by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[July]] [[1995]].
